tags.name: Profile
tags.description: The account a credential belongs to.

tags.name: Tokens
tags.description: The API token a request carries. Tokens are created, rolled and revoked in Settings › API tokens.

tags.name: Devices
tags.description: The phones that record locations (Overland installs), with their latest position and battery.

tags.name: Locations
tags.description: Where the devices have been: every point as it arrived, the places they stayed at (visits) and the all-time heatmap. All of it needs `locations:read`.

tags.name: Tracks
tags.description: Where the devices went, at a level of calculation: as recorded, averaged, mapped onto roads and railways, or as stops and moves.

tags.name: Timeline
tags.description: Stops and moves with their transport modes, the corrections people make to the modes, and distance and time per mode.

tags.name: History
tags.description: History without coordinates: trips, daily statistics and recent activity (`history:read`).

tags.name: People
tags.description: The people who share their location with you, with their devices at the precision they chose.

tags.name: Sharing
tags.description: Your location shared with people (one way, for as long as you choose) and as public links, and the shares people give you.

get.description:
The account the token or session belongs to. Its time zone decides where the account's local days begin and end.

**Access:** an API token with the scope `profile:read`, or a signed-in session.

Checks the API token the request carries and describes it: its name, scopes, devices and expiry. A token that is refused gets the usual 401 instead, so this is the call to test a token with, or to find out when it expires. Only a token can be verified: a signed-in session gets 400.

**Access:** any API token, whatever its scopes; not a session.

Renames the device, switches its silence alerts or queues a settings preset for Overland. Its credentials are out of reach: no token can replace a device's access token or delete a device, which takes a signed-in session. The answer has the device and its settings after the change; the device's position only for a credential with `locations:read`.

**Access:** an API token with the scope `devices:write`, or a signed-in session.

get.description:
The points one device recorded, exactly as the phone sent them (no smoothing, no map matching), oldest first and a page at a time: follow `nextCursor` until it is null. `from` and `to` narrow the range. A phone uploads when it can, so points may arrive later than newer ones: to keep a copy current, ask again for a range that overlaps the end of the last one.

**Access:** an API token with the scope `locations:read`, or a signed-in session.

get.description:
The tracks of the devices in `[from, to)` (at most 93 days) at a level of calculation: `raw` as recorded, `averaged` (outliers dropped, GPS noise smoothed), `mapped` (snapped to roads and railways, with the way's shape between points) or `inferred` (the stops and moves of the timeline, each move with its transport mode). A point that has not reached the level yet is served at the best one below it, and `availableLevel` says which level every point reached. Each device's track is simplified to at most `maxPoints`.

**Access:** an API token with the scope `locations:read`, or a signed-in session.

get.description:
The timeline: the stops and moves overlapping `[from, to)` (at most 93 days), oldest first, a page at a time. A stop has its place (`centroid`) and duration; a move its transport mode — the one a person set, else the inferred one — with the confidence, distance, duration and speeds. `pending` is true while points of the range still wait for processing, so the timeline may still change.

**Access:** an API token with the scope `locations:read`, or a signed-in session.

put.description:
Corrects the transport mode of a move: the mode applies to the move's time and wins over the inference, also when the history is processed again. The inferred mode stays visible as `modeInferred`. Setting the mode it already has changes nothing. A stop has no mode: `409`.

**Access:** an API token with the scopes `locations:read` and `locations:write`, or a signed-in session.

schema.description: The segment's id. It stays the same while the segment keeps its start.

parameters.description: The segment's id. It stays the same while the segment keeps its start.

delete.description:
Withdraws the correction that set the move's mode — a mode set from a moment on with it, for every move it covered — so the inferred mode counts again. The segment answers with the inferred mode at once; the span is worked out again within seconds (a `segments` event follows). Without a correction nothing changes.

**Access:** an API token with the scopes `locations:read` and `locations:write`, or a signed-in session.

get.description:
How the device travels now: the mode set from a moment on that is still in force (`override`), and the current mode — that one, or the latest segment's while it is recent (a stop is `stationary`). `current` is null when the device has not reported for a while.

**Access:** an API token with the scope `locations:read`, or a signed-in session.

post.summary: Set the mode from now on
post.description:
The quick toggle: from now on the device travels by `mode`, until `until` or the next detected stop, whichever comes first. It is idempotent — the same mode again changes nothing — another mode ends the running one and starts anew, and `mode: null` ends it, so inference takes over again.

**Access:** an API token with the scopes `locations:read` and `locations:write`, or a signed-in session.

get.summary: Get distance and time per mode
get.description:
Per local day (the account's time zone) from `from` to `to` (inclusive, at most 400 days), device and transport mode: the distance, the time and the number of segments, and how many of those a person set. Stops count as `stationary`; a segment across midnight counts on both days in proportion to its time.

**Access:** an API token with the scope `history:read`, or a signed-in session.

get.description:
The people who share their location with you, by name, each with the devices they share and where those are, at the precision of the share: approximate and area shares give the centre of a cell around the position, never the position itself. A device's `location` is the newest position inside the share's window (its history, or the last 12 hours for live-only shares); battery and activity appear only when the share includes details. People you hid are left out. `distanceM` starts from your own most recently located device and needs `locations:read` too.

**Access:** an API token with the scope `people:read`, or a signed-in session.

One person who shares with you, as in the list. Someone who does not share with you (any more), or whom you hid, is 404.

**Access:** an API token with the scope `people:read`, or a signed-in session.

A `from` before the shared history starts is moved up to it, so no older point is returned. A person without a share with history for you is 404.

get.description:
The people you share your location with: current shares (not stopped, not ended), newest first, with what each shows and until when, whether the address has an account yet (`pending`), whether the person hid you (`hidden`), and when they last looked.

**Access:** an API token with the scope `shares:read`, or a signed-in session.

shares.description: Current shares (not stopped, not ended), newest first.

post.description:
Starts sharing your location with a person, one way: they see you under People, you do not see them unless they share back. Pick the devices (all by default, also later ones), the precision, history (precise only; live only by default), whether battery and activity come along (yes by default) and the duration. An address without an account gets a `pending` share that starts when someone signs up with it. One current share per address: change it instead (409). At most 50 at a time (409). A token limited to some devices shares only those, listed by id.

**Access:** an API token with the scope `shares:write`, or a signed-in session.

patch.description:
Changes what a current share shows or how long it runs: a `duration` counts from now (extend or shorten), the other fields change only when given. History stays limited to precise shares (400 otherwise). The recipient sees the change at once.

**Access:** an API token with the scope `shares:write`, or a signed-in session.

parameters.name: id

schema.description: The share's id.

parameters.description: The share's id.

delete.description:
Stops a share at once: from this moment the person sees nothing of you, in any read or live event. A pending share is withdrawn before anyone could see it.

**Access:** an API token with the scope `shares:write`, or a signed-in session.

parameters.description: The share's id.

get.description:
The current shares other people give you, newest first — also the ones of people you hid (`hiddenAt`), so you can show them again. Their positions are under People.

**Access:** an API token with the scope `shares:read`, or a signed-in session.

shares.description: Current shares with you, hidden ones included, newest first.

post.description:
Hides the person who gives you this share: they disappear from People and their live updates stop reaching you, until you show them again. They keep sharing and are told that you hid them.

**Access:** an API token with the scope `shares:write`, or a signed-in session.

get.description:
Your public links that were not turned off, newest first, with what each shows, when it expires and how often it was opened. Expired links stay listed for 30 days. Secrets are never listed: a link's address is shown once, when it is made.

**Access:** an API token with the scope `shares:read`, or a signed-in session.

links.description: Links that were not turned off, newest first; expired ones too.

post.description:
Makes a secret web address that shows your location to anyone who has it, without an account: a page with the label, the devices you pick at the precision you pick, optionally their track of the last days (precise only) and battery and activity. It always expires — in 24 hours unless you choose another time, within 30 days — and you can turn it off at any time. The answer carries the secret and the address once; Trail keeps only a hash. At most 20 links work at a time (409).

**Access:** an API token with the scope `shares:write`, or a signed-in session.

secret.description: The link's secret, shown this once.

url.description: The page to send: `<server>/s/<secret>`, shown this once.

delete.description:
Turns a link off at once: its page says that it has ended.

**Access:** an API token with the scope `shares:write`, or a signed-in session.

get.description:
This API described in OpenAPI 3.1, for code generators, HTTP clients and this reference. It changes only with a new release of Trail: cache it for five minutes and revalidate with `If-None-Match`.

**Access:** public, no credential needed.

schema.description: An OpenAPI 3.1 document: this one.

name.description: Its name in Trail, 1 to 60 characters; the phone keeps sending as before.

alertsEnabled.description: Whether the server warns (through ntfy, when its owner set that up) once the device has been silent for a while, and when it sends again.

pendingSettings.description: A preset for Overland, sent once with the answer to the phone's next upload; null withdraws one that has not been sent yet.

DeviceUpdate.description: The changes; leave out what stays as it is.

SettingsPreset.description: A tested set of Overland settings: `balanced`, `balanced-plus`, `high-resolution` (best accuracy, most battery) or `battery-saver`.

ProcessingLevel.description: `raw`: the points as the phone sent them. `averaged`: outliers dropped and GPS noise smoothed. `mapped`: snapped to roads and railways, with the way's shape between points. `inferred`: cut into stops and moves, each move with its transport mode.

SetSegmentModeRequest.description: The mode the segment really had.

ChosenTransportMode.description: A transport mode a person can set: every mode except `unknown`.

mode.description: The mode from now on; null ends the mode set before and inference takes over.

until.description: End it at this time at the latest (it always ends at the next stop).

SetDeviceModeRequest.description: Set the transport mode from now on.

email.description: The person's address. Without an account yet, the share waits for them.

deviceIds.description: The devices to share: ids of your devices, or null for all of them, also the ones added later.

historyDays.description: How many days of past positions the recipient may see; null for live only (the newest position). Only with `precise`.

includeDetails.description: Whether battery and activity (motion, trip, transport mode) are shared too.

CreateShareRequest.description: Start sharing your location with a person.

SharePrecision.description: `precise`: the position as recorded. `approximate`: the centre of a cell about 560 m across (a neighbourhood). `area`: a cell about 5.6 km across (a town or a part of a city). The cells are fixed per share, so repeated reads always give the same answer and cannot be averaged back to the real position.

ShareDuration.description: `hour`: one hour. `endOfDay`: until midnight in the owner's time zone. `week`: seven days. `indefinitely`: until it is stopped.

duration.description: A new duration, counted from now: extends or shortens the share.

deviceIds.description: The devices to share: ids of your devices, or null for all of them, also the ones added later.

historyDays.description: How many days of past positions the recipient may see; null for live only (the newest position). Only with `precise`.

includeDetails.description: Whether battery and activity (motion, trip, transport mode) are shared too.

includeDetails.description: Whether visitors see battery and activity too.

expiresAt.description: When the link stops working: in the future and at most 30 days away. Defaults to 24 hours from now.

id.description: The segment's id. It stays the same while the segment keeps its start.

kind.description: `stop`: the device stayed in one place. `move`: it travelled.

mode.description: The transport mode that counts: the person's choice, else the inferred one. Null for a stop.

modeUser.description: The mode a person set for this time; null when nobody did.

confidence.description: How sure the inference is, from 0 to 1; null for a stop.

averageSpeed.description: Distance over duration in m/s; null for a stop.

bearer.description:
An API token, sent as `Authorization: Bearer trlk_…`. Its scopes decide what it may do; an operation lists the scopes that grant access to it.

| Scope | Allows |
|---|---|
| `profile:read` | Read the account's name and time zone. |
| `devices:read` | List the devices with their name, status, last-seen time and battery, not where they are. |
| `devices:write` | Rename devices, switch their alerts and queue settings presets; never their tokens. |
| `locations:read` | Read positions: where the devices are now and where they have been (points, visits, the heatmap, tracks, the timeline). |
| `locations:write` | Correct how you travelled (transport mode overrides). |
| `history:read` | Read trips, daily statistics and activity: the history without coordinates. |
| `people:read` | See the people who share their location with you. |
| `shares:read` | List your shares, the ones you receive and your public links. |
| `shares:write` | Start and stop sharing, hide people and manage public links. |
